title: model
description: An asset in its own local frame, placed by something else: a doodad, an item, a character, a building.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, by its `$id`: the last path segment names the file in husk's schema/ directory, and schema_version says which version of it (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "The contract header").

schema_version.description: Version of the schema this document conforms to.

space.description: Units and axes of every value in the document.

provenance.description: Who wrote it, when, from what.

definition.description: What exists and is valid for this model.

placement_sets.description: Placement sets this model owns: furniture, decorations, anything it places. Order is identity: selections index this list.

reference.description: The id of the placement_set document's reference.

always_on.description: Shown wherever the model is placed, regardless of selection.

instance_count.description: Number of instances in the set.

texture_slots.description: Textures the model takes from outside. A layer reading a slot has its own texture as a default; any option may replace it, whether or not the source ever used it on this model. A slot no layer reads still lists its options.

source.description: The slot in the source's terms, when it has a texture type.

texture_type.description: The source's replaceable texture type (M2 texture type).

inferred_from.description: How husk tied the slot to the model when the source doesn't state it; absent: stated by the source.

composite.description: The id of the reference to the material document whose composite builds the slot's texture from customization choices (REFACTOR/MATERIALS.md).

particle_colors.description: Ways to recolour the model's particles; any may be chosen.

ramps.description: Ramp i recolours emitters whose particle_color_index is 11 + i.

items.description: One ramp over a particle's life.
Items the model can wear, by identity, and what each draws when resolved.

ref.description: The item: an ItemDisplayInfo row (NPC equipment) or an ItemModifiedAppearance row (--appearance gear).

models.description: The item's own models, one per model position, each the file the wearer's race and sex draw.

position.description: ItemDisplayInfo.ModelResourcesID index; on shoulders 0 is the left model, 1 the right.

model.description: The picked model; uri, when set, is its bundle, also listed in /references.

unresolved_reason.description: Why no file was picked: the wearer is unknown, several files fit equally, or none fits.

texture_type.description: The item model's M2 texture type it fills.

model_position.description: The model position (models[].position) whose model it textures.

overlays.description: Textures the item draws onto the wearer's body sections (ItemDisplayInfoMaterialRes).

customization.description: Customization options a character model offers, each with its valid choices. A model file several character models share (a race's alternate form) lists every one's options, each naming its character model.

chr_model.description: The character model the option belongs to: a ChrModel row, named "<race> <sex>" (e.g. "Human male") from the ChrRaceXChrModel rows that use it: the ChrRaces.Name_lang of the lowest race row with a name (NPC placeholder races share the playable races' models), then ChrRaceXChrModel.Sex (0 male, 1 female; left off when the races disagree or the value is neither). Unnamed when no race uses the model. Lets a reader tell which body a customization catalog is for without the race tables.

category.description: The category the option is listed under; absent when the option has none (CategoryID 0).

geoset_id.description: Mesh geoset the choice shows; group * 100 + variant.

correction_set.description: The .bone correction set the choice selects.

textures.description: Textures the choice binds to a material document's image inputs.

material.description: The id of the material document's reference.

only_with.description: Bound only while this other choice is also made.

terrain.description: How a terrain tile meets its neighbours. Which tiles are neighbours is the world grid's fact, not the tile's.

edge_vertices.description: duplicated: a border vertex is stored by every tile it borders, at the same position in the world frame; heights agree to float precision unless the source tiles differ.

map.description: The map this tile belongs to: the Map row whose Directory is the tile's map directory, named from Map.MapName_lang; absent when no map table was given or no row matches. It lets a tile read alone still know its place; the world document's map block carries the rest of the row.

selection.description: What this model, as exported, has chosen from its definition.

placement_sets.description: Owned sets shown beyond the always-on ones.

reference.description: The id of the item model's reference.

presets.description: Combinations of the definition's options a source is known to use, and where. A renderer may choose any other combination.

textures.description: Texture choices; a slot not listed keeps the layer's texture.

shown_geosets.description: Mesh geoset ids shown; every other geoset is hidden. Absent: the preset doesn't choose geosets.

items.description: Items the combination wears, by identity.

slot.description: The equipment slot; absent when the source's slot has no known name.

source.description: The slot in the source's terms: a number (NPC equipment) or a name (--appearance).

slot_token.description: The source's own slot name, as given.

sources.description: Source rows that use the combination, each with the scale it draws the model at.

users.description: Named things that use the row: for a CreatureDisplayInfo row, the Creature rows listing it (name in the ref, from Name_lang). The client ships only part of the creature list, so many rows have none; absent = none known.

ref.description: The user's row, with its name.

unresolved.description: Source values the combination names but husk can't place in an option.

references.description: Other documents this model depends on.

mesh.description: Triangle geometry: one shared vertex list, triangle indices, and the ranges that draw them.

positions.description: Vertex positions, f32x3: the M2's vertex list, or every WMO group's MOVT in part order.

uv_sets.description: Texture coordinate sets, f32x2, one entry per vertex each, set 0 first: up to two on an M2, up to four on a WMO (one per MOTV), a set a group lacks zero-filled. The client's WMO vertex holds four sets, the fourth read by shader 23, so every vertex carries every set.

colors.description: Vertex colour sets, u8x4 RGBA 0..255 as stored (WMO MOCV, BGRA on disk), a set a group lacks zero-filled.

joints0.description: Skinning joint indices per vertex, u8x4.

weights0.description: Skinning weights per vertex, f32x4, the stored bytes divided by 255.

indices.description: Triangle vertex indices, u32, three per triangle: a .skin's triangle list resolved through its vertex lookup, or each WMO group's MOVI/MOVX offset by the vertices of the groups before it.

primitives.description: Index ranges drawn with one material.

parts.description: Named, separately addressable pieces (rooms, wings, shells): one per WMO group, in MOGI order.

id.description: This part's stable id, derived from the model's identity and the part's source index (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"); everything that names a part uses it.

ref.description: The part: its MOGI index, named from MOGN at the group's name offset.

interior_fogs.description: Fog instances a viewer inside the part sees, beyond the model's default fog (scene.default_fog), in source order (MOGP fogIds into MFOG). Distance fog for that viewer, not fog volumes: nothing in them is a medium to place.

ambient_particle_volumes.description: Ambient particle instances the part uses (MPVR into MPVD).

ambient_color_volumes.description: Ambient colour instances the part uses: point volumes (MAVR into MAVD), then box volumes (MBVR into MBVD).

lights.description: The model's static lights that reach this part (WMO MOLR, MNLR).

items.description: The id of a static light.

light_sets.description: The part's switchable light sets, the k-th set holding the group's spot lights (MOLS) in the k-th MLSS window and point lights (MOLP) in the k-th MLSP window: a renderer lights the part with one of them. Pairing the k-th MLSS and MLSP window into one set is inferred from their parallel layout.

items.description: The id of a static light.

areas.description: What the client names a player's location inside this part, one entry per name set, ascending, from the WMOAreaTable rows keyed by the root's MOHD wmoID (WMOAreaTable.WMOID), the name set (NameSetID) and the group's MOGP groupID (WMOGroupID); absent without a WMO area table, or when the WMO has no rows. A WMO placement's name set (MODF nameSet) picks the entry, since one building placed in two towns carries two names.

items.description: The part's area under one name set.

name_set.description: WMOAreaTable.NameSetID: the MODF nameSet of placements this entry applies to.

ref.description: The WMOAreaTable row, named from WMOAreaTable.AreaName_lang (unnamed when the row stores none; then the area's name is the one shown).

area.description: The AreaTable row the part counts as (WMOAreaTable.AreaTableID), named from AreaTable.AreaName_lang; absent when stored as 0.

whole_model.description: true: the part has no row of its own under this name set, and ref is the model-wide row (WMOGroupID -1).

portals.description: Openings onto other parts: the group's MOGP portal window of MOPR.

to_part.description: The id of the part on the other side.

side.description: The half-space of the portal's plane this part lies in, as the source states it: +1 where dot(normal, p) + distance > 0, -1 where it is < 0, the portal's other link carrying the opposite sign. Not recomputed from geometry: a few source portals (14 of 3,871 cleanly separated ones in a 4,000-root sample) carry the pair flipped against their geometry.

portals.description: Polygons parts see each other through, in MOPT order.

vertices.description: Polygon vertices in source order: the portal's MOPT window of MOPV.

normal.description: Plane normal; dot(normal, p) + distance == 0 on the polygon.

unresolved.description: Fields whose meaning is not established.

extra_record.description: The portal's 16-byte MOPE record (11.1+), raw. Untyped: real records hold ASCII fragments and "MOP" bytes in the documented index field.

attributes.description: Per-element data with no dedicated field.

lod.description: Levels of detail of the mesh, finest first: level 0 is the mesh above, repeated; each later level is a coarser stand-in the source draws from further away (an M2's LOD skins, the SFID entries past numSkinProfiles; a WMO's lod group files, GFID), its primitives naming the mesh's parts and materials. To draw level n, read levels[min(n, max_level)]; every level reads the same way.

max_level.description: The last level the source authored: levels has max_level + 1 entries, 0 when the mesh has no coarser level.

liquids.description: Liquid surfaces: each WMO group's MLIQ.

items.description: A liquid surface as a height grid over tiles; vertex (x, y) is at corner + (x, y) * tile_size with height heights[y * verts_x + x].

part.description: The id of the part the liquid belongs to.

material.description: The id of the surface's material.

liquid_type.description: Liquid type: the LiquidType row the group's stored type selects by the WMO liquid rules (rule wmo_liquid_type); identity kind none when the rules don't decide.

tile_size.description: Edge length of one tile: 25/6 yards, an ADT unit (a map chunk is 8 of them). The source stores no size; the grid uses the client's fixed unit.

heights.description: Vertex heights, f32, row-major, x fastest.

tile_exists.description: Per tile, 1 when liquid is present, u8: the tile's low nibble is not 0xF. MCLQ's convention, which MLIQ shares.

vertex_data.description: Per vertex raw bytes, u8x4: the 4 bytes before the height. Kept raw: they are flow values for water and s/t coordinates for magma, and which one depends on the liquid type's material, outside this file.

collision.description: Triangles to collide with, with their own vertices.

indices.description: Triangle vertex indices, u32, three per triangle.

skeleton.description: Joint hierarchy in bind pose: the M2's bones, or its .skel's (SKB1) when the model has one.

parents.description: Parent joint per joint, i32, -1 for a root.

bind_translation.description: Bind translation relative to the parent, f32x3: the joint's pivot less its parent's.

ref.description: The joint: its bone index, named after its key bone (M2CompBone.key_bone_id) when it is one, else bone_<index>.

billboard.description: How the joint faces the camera: the billboard bits of the bone's flags.

structural_label.description: Label derived from the hierarchy (rule structural_bone_label), on every joint, named or not. It gives every joint a stable, collision-free name where the source names only key bones.

flags.description: The joint's named flag bits, absent when none is set: kinematic_bone, physics drives the joint (a resources.physics body follows it); ignore_parent_*, the joint doesn't inherit that part of its parent's transform; transformed and helmet_anim_scaled, named by the source, effect not established; billboard bits are in billboard instead.
M2: the bone's flag word (M2CompBone.flags), every bit.

animation.description: Clips: per joint local transform curves for one sequence (M2Sequence, inline or the .skel's SKS1, keyframes inline or in its .anim file) or one global sequence; a pure alias sequence reuses its terminal's curves.

sequence_index.description: Sequence or global sequence: its index in the source's sequence or global loop list.

animation.description: Sequence clips: which animation this is, an AnimationData row (Stand, Walk, ...), named from the AnimationData table's Name column (name_source db2, pre-12 clients) when it has one, else from a community list (name_source community, export --anim-names) when given.

variation.description: Sequence clips: which of the animation's variations.

duration.description: Sequence clips: length. Global sequence clips: the loop's length, the period its curves repeat with (the last keyframe can come before it).

move_speed.description: Sequence clips: the movement speed the animation is authored for.

frequency.description: Sequence clips: play weight among the animation's variations.

blend_in.description: Sequence clips: blend time into this clip.

blend_out.description: Sequence clips: blend time out of this clip.

joints.description: Joints with curves in this clip: each bone's M2Track sub-array for the sequence, from the M2's own data or its .anim file (AFM2, or AFSB for a .skel model).

rotation.description: Rotation curve, quaternion x, y, z, w.

global_sequences.description: The model's global sequences, by sequence_index: loops on their own timer that material, scene and effect curves with sequence_kind global_sequence play on; absent when the model has none. A .skel model's joint clips index the .skel's table instead, so each such clip carries its own duration.

duration.description: The loop's length, the period its curves repeat with.

animation_fallbacks.description: AnimationData.Fallback, the client's table of what a model without an animation plays instead: [animation, fallback] AnimationData IDs, ascending, for every row whose fallback isn't 0 (Stand), an ID not listed falling back to 0; absent when the AnimationData table wasn't read or the model has no clips. Follow it until the model has a clip of the animation reached; what the client does on a chain that comes back to where it started is not known.

items.description: One row: the animation, then its fallback.

correction_sets.description: Per-joint correction matrices, one set per .bone file the model's BFID lists; customization choices name the set they select. Data only: how the client applies a correction is not known.

ref.description: The correction file, by its FileDataID.

matrix.description: 4x4 matrix, row-major as stored; its space is not known.

physics.description: Rigid bodies on joints, their collision shapes and the joints between them, from the model's .phys data (its PFDC chunk, its PFID file, or a .phys beside it); values whose layout or unit is not established stay under source as stored. Data only.

bodies.description: Bodies: the newest body chunk present (BDY4, BDY3, BDY2, BODY).

joint.description: The skeleton joint the body follows.

shapes.description: The body's shapes: its shape index range.

source.description: Raw body values with no established meaning (BDY3/BDY4's unk0, _x1c, drag, unk1, _x28; the wiki's defaults for older chunks).

shapes.description: Collision shapes: SHP2 or SHAP, each with its kind's record.

a.description: Capsule: one end of the segment, body frame.

b.description: Capsule: the other end, body frame.

source.description: Box and sphere geometry (BOXS, SPHS) and polytope extras (PLYT), as stored: their layouts are not verified.

joints.description: Joints between bodies (JOIN), each with its kind's record.

source.description: The kind's record as stored (WELJ, SPHJ, SHOJ, REVJ, PRSJ or DSTJ, newest variant, at JOIN jointId): frames (3x4 row-major), limits, motor and spring values; the angle unit is not established.
File-level values as stored: version (PHYS), the type word (PHYT), and the per-file vector records (PHYV).

materials.description: Materials; primitives and liquids refer to them by id.

id.description: This material's stable id, derived from the model's identity and the material's source record (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids").

items.description: One texture layer of a material.

role.description: What the layer contributes, e.g. diffuse, specular, emission.

uv_map.description: What the layer samples its texture with.

texture_unit.description: The shader texture this layer is: t<n> in its techniques' formulas (texture_unit inputs). An M2 pixel shader reads units 0-3; a layer above that is the source's, carried as it is. A WMO material's are its MOMT fields in shader order: texture_1-3 are 0-2, and for shaders 22 and 23, color_2 and flags_2 are 3-4 and runTimeData[0..3] are 17-20.

slot.description: The slot whose options may replace texture.

color_alpha.description: The source colour's opacity over time (M2: M2Color.alpha).

texture_weight.description: The source texture weight over time (M2: M2TextureWeight). Kept apart from color_alpha: how the client combines the two is not established, so the consumer decides.

framebuffer_blend.description: How the result combines with what is already drawn.

pixel_shader.description: M2: the pixel shader the batch's shader ID selects, which defines how the layers combine.

vertex_shader.description: M2: the vertex shader the batch's shader ID selects (its texture coordinate setup, e.g. Diffuse_T1_Env: the second texture environment-mapped).

surface_type.description: What the surface is made of (WMO ground_type). A face's own, when it differs, is the mesh attribute channel surface_type.

techniques.description: The techniques the material is drawn with (its shader, its framebuffer blend), as references.

items.description: The id of one technique's reference.

uv_maps.description: How layers sample their textures: a coordinate set or environment mapping, with its own animation. Layers that sample alike share one entry.

oneOf.description: Sphere environment mapping: coordinates computed from the view-space normal, none stored.

transform.description: Coordinate animation, applied to the coordinates before sampling.

scene.description: Objects the model places that are not geometry.

items.description: A point other models attach to.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

items.description: A light attached to a joint, with animated colour and range.

kind.description: Light kind; unknown when the source type has no established meaning.

bone.description: Joint the object moves with; identity is a record_index into the skeleton's joints.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

attenuation_end.description: Distance where the light reaches zero.

items.description: A light placed in the model, not animated.

id.description: This light's stable id, derived from the model's identity and the light's source record (REFACTOR/BUNDLE_FORMAT.md "Stable ids"); parts name their lights by it.

position.description: Position in model space (not relative to the joint).

rotation.description: Orientation, when stored as a quaternion.

euler_rotation.description: Orientation, when stored as Euler angles; axis order not established.

attenuated.description: Whether it falls off with distance.

attenuation_end.description: Distance where the light reaches zero.

falloff_exponent.description: Falloff exponent; absent when the source has none (WMO MOLS).

inner_angle.description: Inner angle; half or whole cone not established.

cookie.description: Texture projected by the light; a cube map for point lights.

placement_set.description: Owned set the light switches with; absent means always on.

part.description: The id of the mesh part whose own light this is (a WMO group's light-set light); absent for a model-wide light.

unresolved.description: Source values with no field here, carried raw.

record.description: The source record this entry was decoded from.

default_fog.description: The fog instance a part's unlisted fog falls back to: the model's own default fog. Absent: the enclosing fog.

liquid_types.description: Each liquid type this document's liquids (terrain or geometry) name, once.

terrain.description: A heightfield surface: a grid of chunks, each a grid of quads, with texture layers, ground-cover rules and liquids.

lod.description: Levels of detail of the surface, finest first: level 0 is the chunks' heightfield; each later level is a whole-tile mesh the source draws from further away, one per _lod.adt band (MLLL, stored coarsest first). To draw level n, read levels[min(n, max_level)].

max_level.description: The last level the source authored: levels has max_level + 1 entries, 0 when the tile has no coarser level.

chunks_per_side.description: Chunks along each tile edge (16, the ADT's fixed MCNK grid).

row_axis.description: Unit direction rows step along, for chunks, vertices and alpha maps (-x: south).

column_axis.description: Unit direction columns step along (-y: east).

chunk_vertex_layout.description: Vertex order within a chunk: per row pair, 9 corner vertices then 8 quad-centre vertices, 145 in all.

chunk_topology.description: quad_centre_fan: each quad is four triangles around its centre vertex, counter-clockwise seen from +z; a hole quad has none.

textures.description: Ground textures, the _tex0 MDID (or MTEX) list in order; layers index this list.

height.description: Height texture for height-based blending (MHID; 0 there: none).

repeats_per_chunk.description: Times the texture repeats across one chunk along each axis: 8 / (1 << MTXP texture_scale, flags bits 4..7), 8 without MTXP. The base of 8 is a renderer convention with no field on disk.

height_scale.description: Height-blend scale; 0 with height_offset 1 turns height blending off.

ground_effects.description: Ground-cover rules, each GroundEffectTexture row the layers' MCLY effectId names, once; layers index this list.

items.description: A ground-cover rule: the consumer scatters its doodads at runtime; nothing here is an instance.

density.description: Doodads per chunk, as stored; absolute scale unverified.

doodads.description: Weighted doodad choices: the row's DoodadID and DoodadWeight arrays.

identity.description: The doodad record: a GroundEffectDoodad row.

weight.description: Relative weight; use as a ratio.

surface_type.description: What ground under this effect's layers is made of (GroundEffectTexture Sound, a TerrainType row); absent when the build has no row for the effect.

chunks.description: The tile's chunks (root ADT MCNKs), index = row * chunks_per_side + column. Corner vertex (r, c) of a chunk sits at origin + (r * row_axis + c * column_axis) * quad_size; centre (r, c) at origin + ((r + 0.5) * row_axis + (c + 0.5) * column_axis) * quad_size.

origin.description: Per chunk, (x, y) of corner vertex (0, 0) in the tile frame, f32x2: MCNK position less the tile corner.

heights.description: Per chunk, absolute height of each vertex in chunk_vertex_layout order, f32x145: MCNK position z plus the MCVT entry.

normals.description: Per vertex, unit normal, f32x3, 145 per chunk: MCNR's signed bytes / 127, renormalized. Read X, Y, Z: the wiki's "X, Z, Y" comment disagrees with every finite-difference check.

hole_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means quad (r, c) draws nothing; MCNK holes_high_res, or holes_low_res's 2x2-quad blocks expanded when the chunk lacks the high-res flag.

dominant_layer.description: Per chunk, u8x64 row-major: per quad, the layer whose ground effect applies (MCNK's uint2_t[8][8] predominant texture, taken LSB-first). Bit order unverified.

ground_effect_suppressed_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means no ground effect on quad (r, c). Bit order unverified.

liquid_fishable_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means the liquid on quad (r, c) is fishable, always within the chunk's liquid quads.

liquid_deep_rows.description: Per chunk, u8x8: bit c of byte r set means the liquid on quad (r, c) is deep (the source's fatigue flag), always within the fishable quads.

area_index.description: Per chunk, u32: index into areas.

areas.description: Areas the chunks belong to, each once.

items.description: One area: the AreaTable row an MCNK's areaId names, named from AreaTable.AreaName_lang with --db2-dir (unnamed without, or when the table lacks the row). The name lets a tile read alone label its ground.

layers.description: Per chunk, its texture layers (the _tex0 MCNK's MCLY).

items.description: One texture layer of a chunk, bottom first.

ground_effect_index.description: Ground effect the layer scatters: its MCLY effectId's entry in ground_effects; absent for none.

overbright.description: Drawn brighter than its texture (MCLY flag 0x80).

direction.description: Scroll direction, counter-clockwise from +x seen from +z: the flags' 3-bit rotation in 45-degree steps.

speed.description: Scroll speed step, 0..7, the flags' 3-bit speed; its unit is not established.

alpha.description: Layer weight over the chunk, u8, 64x64 row-major, rows stepping along row_axis, decoded from MCAL's three on-disk forms (the WDT MPHD flags pick 8- or 4-bit); absent on layer 0, which covers what later layers leave.

liquid_objects.description: Each LiquidObject the liquids name, once; an id the client builds itself (42, the ocean, and others absent from the table) has only its identity.

identity.description: The LiquidObject row; a liquid's liquid_object equals one entry's identity.

flow_speed.description: Flow speed as stored; unit unverified.

items.description: A liquid surface over a rectangle of one chunk's quads, from one MH2O SMLiquidInstance; vertex arrays are (width + 1) * (height + 1), row-major, rows stepping along row_axis.

chunk_row.description: Row of the chunk it lies in: the MH2O chunk header's index / 16.

chunk_column.description: Column of the chunk it lies in: the MH2O chunk header's index % 16.

liquid_object.description: Liquid object: the LiquidObject row, when liquid_object_or_lvf is 42 or more (below that it is a vertex format number).

quad_exists.description: Per covered quad, 1 when liquid is present, u8: the exists bitmap, all 1 when its offset is 0.

height_source.description: stored: heights were stored per vertex; min_height_level: none stored, flat at the instance's minimum; zero: a depth-only layout, drawn at 0.

heights.description: Absolute vertex heights, f32: the vertex data's heightmap, else min_height_level, else 0, as height_source says.

depth.description: Per vertex depth, f32, 0..1: the vertex data's depth bytes / 255.

uv.description: Per vertex texture coordinates, f32x2: the vertex data's uv words / 8.

liquid_flow.description: The tile's liquid flow map (WDT MAI2 field 0), drawn over the whole tile like lod's diffuse (first stored row at the tile corner, rows along row_axis, columns along column_axis), absent when the source has none: data, not colour, R and G a signed 2D flow vector, 128/255 meaning still (which channel follows which axis, and its sign, are unverified), B 0, A 255. An unresolved flow map is dropped, not referenced: a WDT can name one the build doesn't ship.

textures.description: Every texture the document uses, each once; everything else refers to them by id.

surface_types.description: Every surface the materials, faces or ground effects name, each once.

primitive.description: An index range drawn with one material: an M2 batch (.skin M2Batch over its M2SkinSection) or a WMO group batch (MOBA).

geoset_id.description: Geoset the range belongs to, group * 100 + variant: the submesh's M2SkinSection.skinSectionId; 0 (always shown) on a WMO, which has no geosets.

index_start.description: First index into the mesh's indices: M2SkinSection.indexStart with its Level as the high 16 bits, or MOBA.startIndex plus the indices of the groups before it.

material.description: The id of the material that draws it.

part.description: The id of the part it belongs to.

name.description: Channel name, '<source>.<field>', unique within the mesh or level.

domain.description: Which elements it covers: vertices, faces (one per triangle of indices, in order) or the mesh's parts.

data.description: The values; count is the element count. The channel's name says which source field they are.

mesh_level.description: One level of detail: a complete triangle list over its vertex streams, read like resources.geometry.mesh, a stream two levels share naming the same bytes.

uv_sets.description: Texture coordinate sets, f32x2, one entry per vertex each; set 0 first.

colors.description: Vertex colour sets, u8x4 RGBA 0..255 as stored.

joints0.description: Skinning joint indices per vertex, u8x4.

indices.description: Triangle vertex indices, u32, three per triangle.

primitives.description: Index ranges drawn with one material.

attributes.description: Per-element data over this level's vertices and faces.

source.description: Where the level's geometry came from. Absent on level 0.

file.description: The file holding the level (M2: its LOD skin, by the SFID entry's FileDataID).

part_levels.description: The parts the level draws, each with the source level its geometry is from (WMO: the group file's level). A part whose files stop below this level draws its last one; a part not listed is not drawn at this level.

level.description: The source level drawn: the highest of the group's own files (GFID) at or below this level.

terrain_level.description: One level of detail of a terrain tile.

surface.description: heightfield: draw the chunks (level 0, no other keys). mesh: draw the triangles below.

positions.description: Vertex positions in the tile frame, f32x3, shared by every mesh level: corner (r, c) of the tile's 128 x 128 quads at index r * 129 + c, placed as chunk corners are; centre (r, c) at 16641 + r * 128 + c; then skirt vertices, copies of border corners (MLSI) lowered.

indices.description: The surface's triangles, u32, three per triangle, covering the whole tile: the band's MLLL surface range of MLVI.

skirt_indices.description: Triangles hanging below the level's border, u32: the band's MLLL skirt range of MLVI; empty on the finest mesh level. They hide cracks where the level meets a tile at another level.

diffuse.description: The tile's baked colour (WDT MAID mapTexture), drawn over the whole tile: the image's first stored row lies at the tile corner, rows step along row_axis and columns along column_axis.

normal.description: The tile's baked normal map (WDT MAID mapTextureN), laid out as diffuse.

band.description: The source's band value as stored (4, 8, 16, 32, finest first).

m2_pixel_shader.description: The client pixel shader a M2 batch is drawn with. Its formula is the technique document m2_pixel_shader/<name> the material references (techniques/ in the bundle).
